thread:
Sam: Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A 3 can we get sharper dates for Console canary + autoscale, API sampling defaults, and Optimize quantization suggestions? Need to plan sprints.
Priya: Short answer: staggered. Console canary UI + basic autoscale beta = mid-Q3, GA end-Q3 if no regressions. API sampling defaults change is opt-in in early Q3, default switch later with a deprecation window. Optimize model-level quant suggestions planned late-Q3.
Jordan: to clarify API timeline 3 we'll ship a compatibility param so existing clients don't break. Old behavior kept as `sampling_mode=legacy` for 3 months after the switch.
Sam: thanks. for Console beta, any chance to get pilot access for infra teams? we've got a low-risk app to test autoscale.
Priya: yes, pilot slots are limited but we'll open a signup sheet. I'll post the form in #eng-platform by EOD.
Nora: demo snippet we'll use in office hours:```yaml
canary:
  policy: gradual
  steps:
    - traffic: 10%
    - wait: 15m
    - traffic: 50%
    - wait: 30m
    - traffic: 100%
autoscale:
  min: 1
  max: 10
  target: p95_latency_ms
```
Sam: nice. what telemetry will we expose for pilot teams? need to wire alerts.
Priya: pilot dashboard will show p50/p95 latency, error-rate, and token cost delta vs baseline. We'll include a webhook for alerts.
Jordan: also adding a rollout health metric from the eval harness 3 will flag quality regressions automatically and pause canaries.
Sam: perfect. last question: Optimize suggestions 3 per-model UI or per-workload only?
Priya: per-model first (we think it's most actionable), later we'll add aggregated workload recommendations.
InfraBot: roadmap: q3/features updated by Priya at 1798882750.
Sam: great, appreciate it. I'll sign up and route my team. See you at office hours. :thumbsup:
